description: This source file defines a PHP class 'CustomerActivity' that extends a base controller class in the OpenCart system. It handles the management and display of customer activity reports, including functions for listing, reporting, saving settings, and retrieving report data. The class interacts with models, views, and configuration settings to generate customer activity reports in the OpenCart admin interface.

classes.name: CustomerActivity
classes.description: Controller class for handling customer activity reports within the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the customer activity form for filtering and configuration.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the configuration settings for customer activity reporting.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer activity report page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of customer activity report data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves filtered customer activity data based on request parameters.
